parts.label: f
parts.text:
Replace the block and observe the images of P1 and P2 through side CD of the block so that
the images of P1 and P2 appear one behind the other.
Place two pins P3 and P4 between your eye and the block so that P3, P4 and the images of
P1 and P2, seen through the block, appear one behind the other.
Label the positions of P1, P2, P3 and P4. Remove the block and the pins.
